text:
rachel: Heads up — we saw a sudden jump in playbook skips for the new onboard cohort. ~30% of contacts are missing owner_id so fanout aborted and retries are spiking. anyone on CS-ops?
james: On it. Can you drop a couple example account ids and a quick snippet from the runner logs?
rachel: abc123, def456, ghi789. Logs: `ERROR playbook-runner: missing owner_id -> skipping contact` (retries 3x). Also noticed renewal_flag not set for those accounts.
maria: I see the owner-sync job failed during last deploy window (timeout + partial write). Requeuing the sync now for those orgs.
eli: Heads-up the resync will emit owner-change webhooks which retrigger playbooks. Recommend pausing fanout for affected orgs while we backfill to avoid duplicate sends.
rachel: Good call. Can someone pause cs-onboard-runner for org acme-corp (org ids: 101, 102) until we patch?
maria: Paused cs-onboard-runner for org 101 and 102. Also added a temporary pre-fanout guard: skip if owner_id IS NULL.
playbook-bot: playbook-runner paused by maria at 2025-05-03T15:27:20Z :white_check_mark:
james: After backfill we should run healthscore recalculation and a quick backfill of renewal flags. I'll create a ticket with owners and checklist.
rachel: Please include enablement handoff so they know which customers missed first-touch. This impacts activation + renewal risk.
eli: I'll add sample enablement notes and the nudge copy to the ticket so CS can send targeted follow-ups post-backfill.
maria: Running audit script now: `scripts/contact_owner_audit --since 2025-05-02 --org 101,102`. Will paste results when done.
rachel: Thanks — current impact: 12 accounts missed first-touch email and their renewal risk metric didn't get computed. Need to monitor churn signals overnight.
james: Ticket created: CSOPS-4582. Steps: backfill owner -> run healthscore job -> re-enable fanout -> smoke test on 5 accounts. Tagging @enablement and @sre.
maria: Backfill completed for abc123, def456, ghi789. Owner source set to sync-v2. Healthscore recalculation queued.
playbook-bot: healthscore-job queued (job id 7842)
eli: Smoke tested 5 accounts, fanout processed successfully, emails queued. No duplicates seen.
rachel: Great work team. Leave ticket open for 24h monitoring then close if stable. I'll follow up with the enablement team in AM.
maria: Will post the audit CSV here in a bit.
james: Adding postmortem note and runbook task: add owner presence check earlier in pipeline to avoid future fanout spikes.
rachel: Perfect. Keep updates in this thread so we have a single source of truth.
